verdict.rationale: Better Stack's own docs describe a hosted, branded status page on a custom subdomain via a single CNAME record. They also describe customers subscribing to email updates for the whole page or for selected components. However, no evidence explicitly shows the public page being updated automatically from incident state; the status-page material only lists monitor types and response-time charts. missing for 10: explicit documentation that incident state drives public status page updates, notification channels beyond email, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can publish a hosted public status page — custom domain, subscriber notifications — driven from incident state

citations.quote: Get a beautiful branded status page on your own sub-domain in just a few clicks. Configure a single CNAME record and you’re all set!
Host a branded status page on your own custom subdomain and build confidence in your brand.
Let your customers subscribe to e-mail updates removing the need to reach out to you individually.
Let your customers subscribe to the entire status page or just selected components.
